review.conclusion: No remaining blocker found within the agreed C1b public path/configuration/identity scope.
review.independence: This agent authored only its six independent tests, preserved the complete old GC snapshot and wrote this report. GC/CLI/helper/scheduler/phases implementation was authored by other agents.

checked.finding: The standalone CLI validates bounded selected configuration before the consumer, anchors configured paths to config directory and explicit argv paths to invocation directory, preserves explicit numeric zero, and maps blocked outcomes to exit 2. Explicit DB key/argument remains authority even if missing; an undeclared absent default is not injected, while an existing/default symlink is handed to fail-closed authority checks.

Explicit configuration/scope is required. Checkpoint/archive roots cannot equal or contain project root, overlap results or declared inputs/control roots. Actual entry metadata is captured during enumeration; replacement is rejected before detach. The same task effect guard/native authority path protects live or unresolved attempts; no results task directory is manufactured.

No-follow metadata checks reject redirects and unsupported tree entries; no-replace same-filesystem rename detaches to quarantine. Reclaim runs outside the short task guard, verifies captured identities, and reports success only after completion receipt publication. Unknown detach holds the effect owner; failed reclamation is preserved and later GC reports pending quarantine even when the source path is gone. Cross-device archive refuses rather than copy/delete.
Periodic GC now passes the existing cfg and Lake into run_gc; this is a narrow two-argument authority handoff, not a rewritten ranking policy.
Emergency GC also passes cfg and Lake while preserving the existing externally known active-task retention set.

additional_issues_handled_by_other_autho: Unrepresentable numeric disk threshold was reported as preconsumer input-contract rejection, not an old destructive behavior failure; parent owns its mechanism evidence.

CLI default-missing database initially blocked legitimate legacy cleanup. Parent independently froze the real CLI positive/explicit-missing pair and fixed provenance locally; this report reruns it but does not claim authorship of those tests.
Source-less pending quarantine handling and its draft baseline belong to the GC author, not the four old path behavior failures.
not_claimed: No automatic recovery or deletion retry for unresolved quarantine.
No arbitrary malicious same-UID filesystem writer protection or global filesystem transaction.
No current scientific qualification inferred from keep lists, raw metrics, GC receipts or removal byte counts.
No verification that every external extension/direct caller has migrated to the new explicit scope requirement.

appended_controller_handoff_review.classification: Two new consumer-handoff mechanisms, not old-source behavioral reds and not destructive end-to-end tests.
appended_controller_handoff_review.review: Both use a real temporary IdeaLake and actual controller entry points. The periodic case enters _run_leased and cleanup, verifies the full cfg object, the exact Lake/results/checkpoints/catalog handoff and cleanup-lock release. The disk-pressure case enters _launch_training and verifies the same handoff plus both training/evaluation active IDs and min_free_gb=0. A GCReached BaseException stops at the run_gc spy, avoiding ordinary swallowed Exception false greens. Startup/OS/services and the actual GC consumer are replaced deliberately, so this proves call-chain argument delivery rather than filesystem reclamation.
